verdict.rationale: Buzz documents a scriptable CLI covering channels, repos and workflow trigger/approve, plus a headless agent stack. buzz-agent and buzz-dev-mcp are described as "purpose-built for headless autonomous coding work," and remote agents run on Kubernetes with no desktop control channel. Keypair-based identity and the git-credential-nostr helper allow non-interactive authentication for automation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of running Buzz inside CI pipelines (e.g., a CI recipe or non-interactive auth setup for runners), and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless operation.
